paths.label: Core
paths.title: Core GEX Analysis System
paths.description: GEX calculations, 15-pattern library, single LLM agent (MarketMechanicsAgent), O3-mini integration. WHO→WHOM→WHAT causal attribution framework.
paths.barrier: None - this is the validated foundation achieving 71.5% detection and 91.2% accuracy

paths.label: Trailing
paths.title: Dynamic Trailing Stops
paths.description: Adaptive position management that adjusts stops based on volatility and pattern confidence.
paths.barrier: Trade execution is outside research scope - production trading belongs in AutoTrader-AgentEdge project
paths.unblock: Post-PhD commercialization with dedicated trading system development

paths.label: 6-Cat
paths.title: Six-Category Pattern Classification
paths.description: Gamma Trap, Gamma Squeeze, Vol Compression, Mean Reversion, Momentum, Neutral.
paths.barrier: Each category requires dedicated historical event testing - validation bottleneck with limited time
paths.unblock: Dedicated validation sprints for remaining 5 categories with curated historical events

paths.label: Monte
paths.title: Monte Carlo & Permutation Testing
paths.description: Basic stats completed (Wilson CI, Sharpe ratio, Kelly Criterion). Missing: 10K+ permutation iterations.
paths.barrier: Massive compute for 10K+ iterations; PhD timeline pressure made basic validation sufficient
paths.unblock: Cloud compute budget for large-scale permutation testing

paths.label: CPCV
paths.title: Combinatorial Purged Cross-Validation
paths.description: de Prado's AFML methodology. Proper time-series CV with purging and embargo periods.
paths.barrier: Requires advanced ML validation expertise; with only 7-15 pattern instances per type, sophisticated CV provides marginal benefit
paths.unblock: Scale to 100+ pattern instances; dedicated implementation sprint with ML expertise

paths.label: Seq
paths.title: Sequential Pattern Mining (PrefixSpan)
paths.description: Algorithmic approach using frequency analysis and support/confidence thresholds.
paths.barrier: LLM-based detection became core thesis contribution; algorithmic mining relegated to potential baseline comparison
paths.unblock: Revisit as comparative baseline in future work

paths.label: Multi
paths.title: Multi-Agent LLM Orchestration
paths.description: Complex AutoGen system with specialized agents: DataRetrievalAgent, GEXAgent, PatternAgent.
paths.barrier: Architecture analysis concluded: 75% win rate achieved with single agent. Multi-agent complexity not justified
paths.unblock: Would reconsider only if single-agent hits performance ceiling requiring specialization

paths.label: Few
paths.title: LLM Few-Shot Training Pipeline
paths.description: Full ML infrastructure: example library with quality scoring, context templates, prompt A/B testing.
paths.barrier: Production infrastructure, not research contribution. Simple prompts proved sufficient
paths.unblock: Post-PhD commercialization with dedicated ML engineering team

paths.label: Live
paths.title: Forward-Test Live Trading
paths.description: Real-time paper trading: live data feeds, continuous GEX calculation, position management.
paths.barrier: Production trading system exceeds research scope. Historical backtesting proved sufficient
paths.unblock: Partnership with trading firm for live testing environment

paths.label: Short
paths.title: Short Put Arbitrage Detection
paths.description: Identify anomalous short put positioning indicating dealer hedging pressure.
paths.barrier: Requires fill-side TAQ data ($10K+/year) to determine trade initiator
paths.unblock: Academic data partnership (e.g., WRDS subscription) or institutional sponsorship

paths.label: 0DTE
paths.title: 0DTE Intraday Gamma Dynamics
paths.description: Time-dependent dealer hedging when same-day expiry gamma concentrated.
paths.barrier: Methodological conflict: adding time context breaks obfuscation testing
paths.unblock: Develop relative-time obfuscation that preserves mechanics without revealing market hours

paths.label: Cross
paths.title: Cross-Asset Dealer Hedging Networks
paths.description: Test methodology generalization: Treasury options (TLT), FX options, Commodities.
paths.barrier: Each asset class requires separate literature base, data vendors, potentially years of domain expertise
paths.unblock: Complete Papers 1-3 for credibility; identify multi-asset data vendors

paths.label: 3rd
paths.title: Third-Order Greeks (Speed, Zomma, Color)
paths.barrier: Signal-to-noise ratio makes third-order derivatives unmeasurable with daily data
paths.unblock: Would require tick-level data with sub-second precision AND academic literature establishing predictive value

paths.label: Vol
paths.title: Volatility Greeks (Vomma, Veta, Vanna)
paths.description: Second-order volatility sensitivities requiring full implied volatility surface modeling.
paths.barrier: Requires real-time IV surface data (OptionMetrics ~$15K/year). High LLM hallucination risk
paths.unblock: Partnership with volatility surface provider; separate research focus on vol trading

paths.label: Win
paths.title: Pattern Win Rate Validation
paths.description: Validating win rates for each pattern type across different market regimes.
paths.barrier: Requires extensive historical data and dedicated validation effort
paths.unblock: Systematic backtesting framework with regime-specific analysis
